messages:
ana_cs: Quick flag  Brookside renewal negotiation. Customer asks for monthly installments vs standard upfront. They also want SSO and an extra enablement session bundled. Need path on payments + vendor code. Doc: https://docsend.com/view/brookside-renewal-2026

ben_se: usage healthy but peak in Q2. If they go monthly we need to model added churn risk. Also they asked if Redwood can support their SSO via SAML.

claire_ae: customer contact is emma@brookside.ai (Finance). They requested invoice in EUR and asked about VAT handling.

omar_proc: if they want PO, we need W9 (US) or W-8/W-9 equivalent + remit address. For EU entity we need VAT ID and billing entity. Vendor-code turnaround ~48h after docs. Monthly installments ok but requires billing ops approval.

lina_legal: SAML addendum is fine; we'll add an SSO appendix. For monthly installments we need a payment plan clause: "Customer will be invoiced monthly; missed payments may trigger service suspension after 15 days." Approve adding.

pricing-team: Monthly installments -> +9% uplift to protect cashflow. If prepaid annual -> -7% discount. Enablement bundled? If they pay upfront we can include one complimentary training session. If monthly, training billed as add-on.

ana_cs: spelled name is ana_cs, but noted. I will ask Emma which billing entity (EU subsidiary vs US parent) and whether they can provide VAT number. Also ask if they prefer ACH, wire, or card for installments.

emma@brookside.ai: (via DM) We prefer monthly EUR invoices to our EU subsidiary (Brookside Europe GmbH). VAT ID DE123456789. Card not preferred for recurring enterprise. Can do monthly SEPA or net30 wire. Also want two enablement sessions in Q2.

omar_proc: SEPA monthly is fine; procurement needs remit address + VAT invoice details to create vendor code. Send docs to procurement@redwood.com. Note: non-USD requires FX conversion on our side and VAT handling by finance.

fraud-team: if customer requests monthly and SEPA, low fraud risk. Wire/ACH >$100k will trigger additional review.

lina_legal: propose clause for VAT: "Customer is responsible for VAT where applicable; Redwood will issue invoices with VAT shown when provided a valid VAT ID." Also include SSO appendix. Legal OK otherwise.

pricing-team: final pricing proposal: EUR list price converted at current FX + 9% uplift for monthly plan. Enablement two sessions billed separately unless they prepay 6 months upfront; then include one session complimentary.

ana_cs: uploaded amendment SOW_v5 with monthly payment plan options and SSO appendix. Created DocuSign envelope for Brookside Renewal (SOW_v5). Signer: emma@brookside.ai.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: Brookside Renewal (SOW_v5). Status: awaiting signer: emma@brookside.ai

omar_proc: once VAT and remit address are received we'll start vendor-code creation. If they choose SEPA monthly, procurement to confirm acceptance and set billing terms.

ana_cs: customer sent VAT + remit: Brookside Europe GmbH, Hauptstrasse 22, 10115 Berlin. VAT DE123456789. Emma confirms monthly SEPA.

omar_proc: vendor-code queued. Expect vendor-code in ~36h once docs validated. We'll set payment terms net30.

pricing-team: approved final offer. Ticket to finance to set FX monthly conversion rules.

ana_cs: TL;DR: Brookside chooses monthly SEPA to EU entity, VAT provided, vendor-code in progress, legal and pricing approved uplift. Enablement scheduled after signature. Target: finalize renewal by end of month. :white_check_mark:
